blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Office of the Ombudsman on Thursday said it had ordered the six-month preventive suspension of Sigma, Capiz Vice Mayor Stephen Alayon over his alleged inaction on a water system solar project. The Ombudsman said the preventive suspension without pay was imposed as a precautionary measure to prevent the vice mayor from potentially influencing the proceedings while his administrative cases are pending resolution. “Records show that there is strong evidence of guilt against respondent for the complained act of grave abuse of authority also known as oppression,” the Ombudsman said in its order.
